import pandas as pd

items = pd.read_csv("order_items.csv")
items["revenue"] = items["quantity"] * items["unit_price"] * (1 - items["discount"])

per_order = items.groupby("order_id").agg(
    revenue=("revenue", "sum"),
    lines=("order_item_id", "count"),
    units=("quantity", "sum"),
)

avg_order_value = round(per_order["revenue"].mean(), 2)
multi_line_share = round((per_order["lines"] >= 2).mean(), 3)
top_product = items.groupby("product_id")["revenue"].sum().idxmax()
print(per_order.head())

checks.test: isinstance(per_order, pd.DataFrame) and len(per_order) == 2066 and {'revenue', 'lines', 'units'} <= set(per_order.columns)
